podcast.title: Girl Band Comeback (2010s)
podcast.body: Blackpink was cited as an example of the comeback of girl bands during the 2010s. Their rise to prominence underscored a broader trend of multi-member vocal groups regaining significant popularity in the music industry. "Girl bands came back. Think one direction. Think Blackpink."
